name: @nanobpm/agentic-blackboard
description: Blackboard family for the Nano agentic protocol (ADR 0056, S7): promotes nano-workforce's per-plan blackboard HTTP hook to a first-class, capability-scoped `blackboard` channel-message family — idempotent dedupeKey append, file-claim conflict reporting, and since/cursor incremental reads over the app DataLayer/SQLite, plus a self-contained family module that attaches to the S1 hub via its registerFamilyHandler(family, handler) seam. Built on @nanobpm/agentic-protocol and @nanobpm/agentic-channel.
